# fmt-eigen

fmt formatting of Eigen matrices (header-only): the cscosine copy of
[RENyunfan/fmt-eigen](https://github.com/RENyunfan/fmt-eigen), built and released by
[third_party_base_libs](https://github.com/cscosine/third_party_base_libs). Upstream's README:
[fmt-eigen/README.md](fmt-eigen/README.md); where this copy comes from and what we changed:
[cscosine/README.md](cscosine/README.md). The header keeps upstream's MIT notice.

## Getting started

fmt-eigen is built by the project that consumes it: no setup or build CI of its own. Formatting and checks:
`pre-commit install` once, then `pre-commit run --all-files` (also run by `.github/workflows/checks.yml`).

The shared files (setup, checks, CI, agent rules) come from
[cs-project-template](https://github.com/cscosine/cs-project-template); to bring them to its latest version, on a
branch: `copier update --defaults`.
